what: R14: what closing lint's machine changed in evidence/ladder/r13b/shapes.json. 'changes': every (profile, shape, rung, property) whose status differs from the record at before.commit. 'exposure': every Sound FAILS cell of the scope profiles whose exposure figure differs from the one the machine at before.commit measured (there: the worst within max(3, in_flight + 1) requests wherever the register can fall; here: the worst over any number of requests), at shapes.json's cap, amounts and in_flight. The caller column has one figure per number of sessions and is not listed under 'exposure'.

before.exposure: kamanu.fast.exposure.exposure at that commit, on each of its Sound FAILS rows (evidence/ladder/r14/exposure_before.json)
